The 2027 Alliance Delta 252RL Is an Exceptional Travel Trailer for Couples Who Plan Long RV Trips
25 photos
Photo: Alliance RV
Nowadays, people don’t use their RVs only for short weekend escapes. Many spend weeks or months away from home, so having a well-equipped RV to call home on the road is an essential requirement. For couples looking for a travel trailer capable of supporting extended travel, remote work, or full-time RVing, the 2027 Alliance Delta 252RL is a phenomenal choice.
With residential living comfort, all-weather construction, a factory-installed solar package, Starlink prep, ample room for personal belongings, upgraded towing gear, and large waste capacity, this couples’ travel trailer is ready for extended boondocking stints.
Though it has only been around since 2019, Alliance RV is a well-known name in the RV industry. Founded by industry veterans Coley Brady and Ryan Brady, the company is one of the few independently owned RV manufacturers out there, and its goal is to deliver premium, lightweight RVs at an accessible price point.
But what helped it achieve notable success in a relatively short time is the company’s dedication to quality, innovation, and customer-driven product development. Instead of following industry trends, Alliance RV focuses on listening to customer feedback, and this helped it grow its lineup of RVs considerably.
Photo: Alliance RV The company’s Delta range of travel trailers, for instance, offers a slew of floor plans, so whether you’re a solo traveler, a couple, or a family that travels together, there is at least one model to suit you. The 2027 Delta 252RL presented here is a great example of the level of comfort and livability Alliance travel trailers are designed to offer.
Designed for couples who want to spend extended periods on the road in comfort and style, this model boasts a rear living layout (hence the “RL” in its name), with a private front bedroom and a walk-through bathroom, and offers a practical setup for longer trips .
It has an overall length of 29 feet 11 inches (9.1 meters) and a dry weight of approximately 6,545 pounds (2,968 kg), which makes it an agile half-ton towable. Equipped with dual axles, Goodyear Endurance tires, and a heavy-duty MORryde CRE3000 suspension system, the RV features an aluminum body construction with double-sided composite sidewalls, composite floors, and an all-new fiberglass front cap with an elevated logo.
Photo: Alliance RV On the campsite, an 8-foot (2.4-meter) power awning with dimmable lights, an exterior griddle/grill combo, and a stowable picnic table create the perfect setup for spending time outdoors. At the front, a large pass-through storage compartment provides space for large equipment and integrates the RV’s control center.
Two 20-pound propane tanks and a BAL auto-leveling system that makes setting up at a campsite easier are also included at the front, while an oversized rear ladder, a 300-pound rated accessory hitch, and a spray port are integrated at the back.
The Delta 252RL boasts a large slide-out and offers a rare two-door floor plan. The main door opens into the living area, while a private secondary door enters the front master suite, allowing access to the bedroom and bathroom even when the slideout is not deployed.
Couples who want a wide open floor space will love the interior of this travel trailer. The slideout, which houses a three-seat theater style sofa with atrium windows all around, considerably increases the living space. The theater recliners face a 40-inch Smart HDTV mounted on a swing arm, and an integrated electric fireplace adds warmth and charm.
Photo: Alliance RV A booth dinette is integrated at the rear of the trailer, providing a dedicated place to eat or work for two people. It comes with both under-bench and overhead storage and it also converts into a small guest bed. A dual pull-out pantry is neatly integrated next to the dinette, showing just how efficiently every square inch of space is put to good use.
The nearby kitchen has an L-shaped configuration, and though it’s not very large, it is well-equipped for cooking your own meals during extended adventures. It features solid-surface countertops with a flip-up extension, a matching backsplash, an oversized farmhouse-style stainless-steel sink, and a tip-out trash can, while the appliance package includes a three-burner cooktop, an oven, a microwave, and a 10 cu. ft. refrigerator.
The updated interior for the 2027 model year brings fresh cabinetry colors, new flooring, and slide fascia, as well as matte black cabinet hardware and residential-style cabinet doors. Soft-close hidden hinges and roller shades add to the residential feel and everyday practicality. Alliance RV has also kept the interior carpet-free, making it easier to keep the interior clean.
Photo: Alliance RV The private front bedroom has a residential feel and is separated from the main living area by the walk-through bathroom. It is fitted with a 60-by-80-inch (152-by-203-cm) walk-around queen bed, nightstands, wardrobes, under-bed storage, and device-charging ports built into the nightstands.
The bathroom is also designed for comfort on longer trips with a large 30-by-36-inch shower with a skylight, a porcelain foot-flush toilet, and an angled vanity with dedicated linen storage.
The travel trailer’s utility systems are also designed to support extended travel . The 252RL comes standard with a solar package that comprises a 200-watt solar panel, a 3,000-watt inverter, and a 30-amp MPPT solar charge controller. Other features that support the trailer’s touring capabilities include dual high-efficiency Furrion Chill Cube AC units, a Blu-Tech water filter, a tankless hot water heater, preparation for a backup camera, tire monitoring system, Starlink, and satellite equipment.
Photo: Alliance RV With a dry weight of 6,545 pounds (2,968 kg) and a gross vehicle weight of 8,550 pounds (3,878 kg), the Delta 252RL has a cargo carrying capacity of 2,005 pounds (909 kg). It carries 45 gallons (170 liters) of fresh water, 90 gallons (340 liters) of gray water, and 45 gallons (170 liters) of black water. The generous gray water capacity is useful for couples planning longer trips, allowing for more time between tank dumps. 12-volt holding tank heaters help protect the plumbing in colder weather.
All in all, the 2027 Alliance Delta 252RL travel trailer offers residential-style comfort and exceptional utility for long-term travel without entering the highest price brackets. Its MSRP starts at a reasonable $60,053.
